table.retrieve:
select 
	icode,
	documentcode = 'SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SaleInvCode, 10))), 
	invcode=SL.saleinvcode,
	itemname=(select name from item where item.icode=SD.icode),
	date=SL.date,
	rate=saleprice,
	qty=looseqty, 
	bonusqty=bonusqty,
	discval=SD.looseqty*((SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)* SD.discperc*0.01)+(SD.looseqty*SD.itemflatdisc),
	amount=(looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc))*(1 - SD.discperc*0.01),
	gstperc=SD.gstperc,
	taxval=((bonusqty+looseqty)*unitsalestax )+( looseqty*(saleprice-itemflatdisc)*(1 - SD.discperc*0.01))*SD.gstperc*0.01
from saledetail SD,
	saleledger SL
where SL.date >=:ar_sdate and 
	SL.date<= :ar_edate and	
	SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode


UNION ALL


select 
	icode,
	documentcode = 'SR-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SRInvCode, 10))), 
	invcode=SL.srinvcode,
	itemname=(select name from item where item.icode=SD.icode),
	date=SL.date,
	rate=(srprice)* (-1),
	qty=looseqty,
	bonusqty=bonusqty,
	discval=(SD.looseqty*(SD.srprice* SD.discperc*0.01)) * (-1),
	amount=(looseqty*(SD.srprice - SD.discperc * 0.01))* (-1),
	gstperc=SD.gstperc,
	taxval=(((bonusqty+looseqty)*unitsalestax)+( looseqty*(srprice - SD.discperc*0.01))*SD.gstperc*0.01)* (-1)
from srdetail SD,
	srledger SL
where SL.date >=:ar_sdate and 
	SL.date<= :ar_edate and	
	SL.srinvcode=SD.srinvcode
ORDER by date,
	 invcode,
	 itemname
